premise.claim: Docs-only PR: 'The existing CacheRuntime samples only read and write small files from busybox' — no CacheRuntime sample shows a realistic workload (inference serving) reading model weights through the Fluid PVC.
premise.evidence: git grep -il vllm <base> -- docs/ = no hits; existing samples use busybox write/read jobs (results/unit.out: P0_no_prior_vllm_sample)

findings.summary: Every code-checkable claim in the new sample docs matches the Fluid codebase (pod label, links, en/zh parity, heredoc safety, cross-doc refs, YAML-vs-CRD fields, TOC entries, DataLoad phase).

Merge-order dependency: Step 1 delegates to curvine_cache_runtime.md, whose CacheRuntimeClass heredoc deploys curvine/curvine:0.3.6-alpha (tag does not exist on Docker Hub; real tag is v0.3.6-alpha) and is an unquoted cat<<EOF that mangles ${CURVINE_HOME} into empty strings when the reader runs it. Sample is unrunnable until #6252 merges. RED at heads 33c1eef and 46cd547; expected green once #6252 lands.

External vLLM claims: vllm-openai:v0.33.0 entrypoint is 'vllm serve' (positional model arg valid) and the VLLM_PORT URI guard exists in vllm/envs.py — the doc's enableServiceLinks:false / vllm-svc mitigation matches real vLLM behavior.
